name: Iwasaki Shuusaku
source:
Shuusaku is a member of the Japanese Imperial Demon Army and Makoto Narumi's squad in the Moon Demon Company. 

He is always focused and tends to stay silent. He is a strong player with both wisdom and courage, supporting Narumi in terms of tactics.

[From [url=http://owarinoseraph.wikia.com/wiki/Shusaku_Iwasaki]Owari no Seraph Wiki[/url]]
